article.title: Inside a Palestinian family’s agonizing decision to abandon their home under threat of Israeli settler violence
article.author: Qassam Muaddi
article.content: For three generations, Ali Abu Khdeir's family lived in the home his grandfather built in Deir Jarir until Israeli settlers made staying too dangerous. Now residents fear that their families are next.
source_folders: 06_左派ニュース・社会主義戦略
